# Station launchers under every `.fankeel/` Implementation Plan

**Goal:** every project's `.fankeel/` holds a `station.bat` and a `station.sh` that open that machine's station, generated by the plugin rather than hand-written at this repository's root.
**Architecture:** a new `lib/launchers.js` renders the two files from its own install path and writes them only when their bytes differ; `registry.ensureLayout` calls it once per process per root, inside a try/catch, and appends both names to `.fankeel/.gitignore` through `ensureIgnored`. The port dedupe is already `scripts/station.js`'s `serve --detach` (it probes `serve.json` and opens the running url), so nothing new is written for it.
**Tech Stack:** Node.js built-ins only (`node:fs`, `node:path`), `node --test`; no dependencies (`package.json` has none and declares no `engines`).
**Spec:** [design.md](../../.fankeel/build/task-20261002T085159/design.md)

## Global Constraints

- No dependencies may be added: `package.json` lists none; `npm test` is `node --test`.
- No `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root; conventions come from the code: `'use strict';` first line, 4-space indentation in `lib/`, 2-space in `tests/registry.test.js` (match the file you edit).
- `.fankeel/` content is version-controlled by default; every ignored path under it is listed in `.fankeel/.gitignore` and must have a row in the lifetime table of `docs/90-agent/reference/documents.md` — `tests/docs.test.js:538` asserts it against the on-disk `.fankeel/.gitignore`.
- `ensureIgnored` (`lib/registry.js:212`) appends only missing lines and never rewrites a hand-edited line; reuse it, never a second append.
- A hook path must not throw: `ensureLayout` runs inside `writeSession` (`lib/registry.js:282`) and `replace` (`:405`), whose callers are hooks that exit 0 on every path.
- Test temp dirs come from `tests/tmp.js` (`const tmp = require('./tmp.js'); tmp(prefix)`), required by 132 test files per `.fankeel/map.md`.
- An implementer runs only its own test command, never the full suite; the parent runs `node --test` before committing.
- Deleting a tracked file is done by deleting it from the working tree; the implementer runs no `git` write command.

## Risks

- `ensureLayout` now appends to an existing, committed `.fankeel/.gitignore`, so a test fixture that commits `sessions/\n` and then runs a hook sees `.fankeel/.gitignore` modified and may read it as a write of the task — Task 2 — it puts the two launcher names in the committed fixture of `tests/dirty.test.js:38`, `tests/inject.test.js:455` and `tests/land.test.js:32`, so `ensureIgnored` has nothing to append there.
- `tests/registry.test.js:217` asserts the `.gitignore` is exactly `sessions/\n` after a `writeSession` — Task 2 — it changes that expectation in its first step.
- `tests/registry.test.js:220-227` overwrites `.gitignore` after a first `ensureLayout` and expects a later `writeSession` not to touch it — Task 2 — the once-per-process-per-root `Set` keeps the second call from appending; the test stays as it is and must stay green.
- `--root <project>` adds the project to `roots.json` (`scripts/station.js:282-288`, `rememberLeads`) — none of the tasks — the project is already a registry, so this only records a lead `discover` would find anyway.

// `.fankeel/` (docs/90-agent/plans/2026-10-02-station-launchers.md, Task 1).

const path = require('node:path');

const tmp = require('./tmp.js');

const PLUGIN = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const read = (root, name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.fankeel', name), 'utf8');

    assert.deepEqual(launchers.NAMES, ['station.bat', 'station.sh']);
    assert.equal(launchers.PLUGIN, PLUGIN);

    const script = path.join(PLUGIN, 'scripts', 'station.js');
    assert.equal(read(root, 'station.bat'), '@node "' + script + '" serve --detach --open --root "%~dp0.." %*\r\n');

test('station.sh runs the same script with forward slashes and --root on the project', () => {
    const root = tmp('fankeel-launchers-');

    const script = path.join(PLUGIN, 'scripts', 'station.js').split(path.sep).join('/');
    assert.equal(read(root, 'station.sh'),

3. Write the implementation. Create `lib/launchers.js`:

```js
'use strict';

// The station launchers every registry gets under `.fankeel/`: double-click
// `station.bat` on Windows, run `station.sh` elsewhere. Each holds this plugin
// install's absolute path, so they are per machine — `registry.ensureLayout`
// lists them in `.fankeel/.gitignore` — and each is rewritten only when the
// bytes it should hold differ from what is there, which is how a plugin upgrade
// that moves the install reaches them on the next hook. Starting a second
// station is not this file's concern: `serve --detach` probes `serve.json`
// first and only opens the browser on a station that answers
// (scripts/station.js, the `args.detach` branch).
//
// No require of `./registry.js`: registry requires this file, and `.fankeel/`
// is spelled out below rather than taken from `stateDir` to keep it that way.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const PLUGIN = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const NAMES = ['station.bat', 'station.sh'];

function contents(pluginRoot) {
    const script = path.join(pluginRoot, 'scripts', 'station.js');
    const slashed = script.split(path.sep).join('/');
    return {
        'station.bat': '@node "' + script + '" serve --detach --open --root "%~dp0.." %*\r\n',
        'station.sh': '#!/bin/sh\nexec node "' + slashed + '" serve --detach --open --root "$(dirname "$0")/.." "$@"\n',
    };
}

function write(projectRoot, pluginRoot) {
    const dir = path.join(projectRoot, '.fankeel');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const want = contents(pluginRoot || PLUGIN);
    const written = [];
    for (const name of NAMES) {
        const file = path.join(dir, name);
        let have = null;
        try {
            have = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
        } catch (e) { /* not written yet, or not a file: write it below */ }
        if (have === want[name]) continue;
        fs.writeFileSync(file, want[name]);
        if (name.endsWith('.sh')) fs.chmodSync(file, 0o755);
        written.push(name);
    }
    return written;
}

module.exports = { NAMES, PLUGIN, contents, write };
```

3. Write the implementation. In `lib/registry.js`, below the line `const { readObject: readFile } = require('./json.js');` (line 19), add:

```js
// The station launchers every registry gets under `.fankeel/` (ensureLayout).
const launchers = require('./launchers.js');
```

and in `lib/registry.js`, replace the comment and body of `ensureLayout` (lines 197-207) with:

```js
// Written the moment the directory is created rather than left to the entry
// skill, because a skill is read by a model and this is not the kind of thing
// that may depend on being remembered. One line, so that anything added under
// `.fankeel/` later is version-controlled by default, with an explicit list of
// exceptions rather than the other way round: `sessions/` here, the two
// station launchers just below, and what `ensureIgnored`'s other callers add.
//
// The launchers (lib/launchers.js) hold this machine's plugin path, so they
// are ignored, and they are checked once per process per root — a hook is one
// process, so that is once per hook — inside a try/catch: a launcher that
// cannot be written must not cost the session write this rides on.
const launched = new Set();
function ensureLayout(projectRoot) {
    const dir = sessionsDir(projectRoot);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const ignore = path.join(stateDir(projectRoot), '.gitignore');
    if (!fs.existsSync(ignore)) fs.writeFileSync(ignore, 'sessions/\n');
    if (launched.has(projectRoot)) return;
    launched.add(projectRoot);
    try {
        launchers.write(projectRoot);
        ensureIgnored(projectRoot, launchers.NAMES);
    } catch (e) { /* a launcher is a convenience; see above */ }
}
```
